title: The Pumbeditans Say

paragraphs: Pesachim 104a. Rav Sheshet said to Rav Amram: “Perhaps you are from Pumbedita, where they pass an elephant through the eye of a needle” (Bava Metzia 38b). “The judges of Pumbedita” refers to Rav Papa bar Shmuel; “the Amoraim of Pumbedita,” to Rabbah and Rav Yosef; “the sharp ones of Pumbedita,” to Eifa and Avimi, the sons of Rechava; and “the elders of Pumbedita,” to Rav Yehudah and Rav Eina, as in Sanhedrin 17b.
